verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own marketing page explicitly states RTX 50-series GPUs are optimized for 'Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch, and other inference backends,' and the CUDA Toolkit page documents the general CUDA/C++ tooling that underlies PyTorch's GPU backend, but there is no dedicated PyTorch support matrix, CUDA/cuDNN version compatibility table, or independent benchmark confirming PyTorch training/inference works on this specific card. missing for 10: official PyTorch install/support matrix naming RTX 5070 Ti or Blackwell architecture, independent hands-on confirmation of PyTorch functioning on the card, and cuDNN/CUDA version compatibility documentation.
